transcript: Speaker A: Aap kya padh rahi hain? [What are you reading?] Speaker B: I reading newspaper. Speaker A: Aise boliye, "I am reading a newspaper." Speaker B: Mujhe English bolne mein problem hoti hai. [I have a problem speaking English.] Speaker A: Koi baat nahi, roz 15 minute practice se aap confidently English bol sakti hain. [No problem, with 15 minutes of daily practice, you can speak English confidently.] Speaker B: Practice kahan karun? [Where should I practice?] Speaker A: Speakeasy app par. [On Speakeasy app.] Speaker B: Is app mein kya hota hai? [What happens in this app?] Speaker A: Speakeasy ek English learning app hai jahan main yaani ki aapki AI English teacher Vani aapko Hindi mein samjha kar English ki practice karaungi. [Speakeasy is an English learning app where I, your AI English teacher Vani, will help you practice English by explaining in Hindi.] Speaker B: Par yeh toh expensive hoga na? [But this must be expensive, right?] Speaker A: Bilkul nahi, sirf ₹1 se aap English practice shuru kar sakti ho. [Not at all, you can start practicing English for just ₹1.] Speaker B: Main abhi install karti hoon. [I will install it right now.] Speaker C: Abhi Speakeasy app download karein aur farratedar English bolna shuru karein. [Download Speakeasy app now and start speaking fluent English.]
on_screen_text: Aap Kya Padh [What are you reading]... Speakeasy AI. Speak English Easily with Speakeasy. Install Now. GET IT ON Google Play. Download on the App Store.
summary: An AI robot teacher corrects a woman's English grammar while she reads a newspaper. The AI introduces the Speakeasy app, explaining that users can practice English with an AI teacher for just ₹1. The ad ends with a call to action to download the app.
